paper.title: Accurate and Robust Stellar Rotation Periods catalog for 82771 Kepler stars using deep learning

result.summary: 本文提出了 LightPred，一个从 Kepler 光变曲线中提取恒星自转周期的深度学习模型，采用 LSTM 与 Transformer 双分支架构，并先以自监督对比学习在 Kepler 数据上预训练，再用模拟光变曲线进行监督训练 [abstract][S1.p3][S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3][S4.SS2.p1]。在模拟数据上，LightPred 在准确率和平均误差上优于 ACF 等经典方法，并能对全部样本给出预测 [abstract][S5.SS1.p2]。作者将其应用于 Kepler 数据，生成了迄今最大的自转周期星表，最终保留 82771 条可靠预测 [abstract][S5.SS3.p2]。分析还确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星存在潮汐同步现象 [abstract][S6.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在从 Kepler 光变曲线中准确、稳健地测量恒星自转周期，并解决经典方法在大样本上耗时、难以处理复杂光变曲线、且无法给出不确定性估计的问题 [S1.p1][S1.p2][S1.SS1.p1]。作者指出，恒星自转周期的研究对理解恒星演化、活动周以及系外行星探测日益重要 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
but can be time-consuming and challenging to apply to large datasets.
One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions

method.text: LightPred 采用双分支架构：时间分支以 Diff-ACF 为输入，包含卷积嵌入、双向 LSTM 和自注意力模块；全局分支以 Diff-Lc 为输入，使用修改版 AstroConformer [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3]。两分支特征拼接后经预测头输出自转周期、倾角及各自的置信度分数 [S3.SS1.p4]。训练分两步：先在 Kepler 样本上以自监督对比学习预训练主干，再用模拟光变曲线进行监督训练 [S4.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Temporal branch - consists of an ”embedding” convolution block with max pool, dropout, batch normalization, skip connection, a bi-directional LSTM block, and a non-learnable self-attention block.
Global branch - here we follow the recent work of called Astroconformer.
The output of the model is four numbers: rotation period, inclination, period confidence score, and inclination confidence score.
First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
Next, we used the weights from the SSL Step as an initialization for supervised training with the mock dataset.

experiments.text: 作者使用 Butterpy 生成的模拟光变曲线进行监督训练，并注入真实 Kepler 噪声，训练集为 50000 个模拟样本，按 81%/9%/10% 划分训练、验证和测试集 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p1]。在模拟数据上，作者与 Tel-Aviv 团队报告的 ACF 结果比较，并自行实现了 ACF 和 GPS 方法进行对比 [S5.SS1.p2]。在 Kepler 数据上，作者对 130868 个样本进行预测，经筛选后用于最终星表 [S5.SS2.p1][S5.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy
Next, we injected noise from real Kepler data.
This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days
We then split the dataset into training ( $81\%$), validation ( $9\%$), and test sets ( $10\%$).
We compare our results to the results reported by the Tel-Aviv team in.
we also implemented ACF and GPS methods and tested them on our test set.
This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.

findings.text: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声和无噪声样本上的表现均优于 ACF，且能预测全部样本，而 ACF 和 GPS 仅能有效预测约 85% 的数据 [S5.SS1.p2]。模型输出的置信度与绝对误差呈高置信度对应低误差的趋势 [S5.SS1.p3]。在 Kepler 数据上，模型预测的观测误差与模拟误差在周期小于 40 天时存在单调关系，小于 25 天时近似线性 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2]。自监督预训练显著改善 Kepler 数据上的观测误差，约降低 3 倍 [S5.SS2.SSS2.p3]。分析食双星确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的潮汐同步现象 [S6.p3]。

evidence.quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
It can be seen that both ACF and GPS predicted effectively $\sim 85\%$ of the dataset while our model predicted the entire dataset.
The trend of high confidence and low error, which can be easily seen in the figure
It can be seen that for prediction $<40$ days, there is a clear monotonic relationship between simulation and observational errors.
For predictions $<25$ days, the relation appears linear.
the improvement on Kepler data is significant ( $\sim 3$ times lower observational error).
our analysis of eclipsing binaries confirms tidal synchronization in systems with orbital periods shorter than 10 days

limitations.text: 作者指出，模拟所依赖的 spot 模型存在倾角与 spot 位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验分布，spot 分布对结果影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。对于周期大于 25 天的样本，模拟误差与观测误差的相关性不同，可能与较老恒星活动性下降有关 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2]。模型对极快自转体（周期小于 3 天）存在局限 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p5]。此外，作者承认在周期发生剧烈变化的光变曲线中，模型通常给出“平均”预测，哪种结果更好尚不明确 [S5.SS2.SSS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
This implies that the model is prior-depended: the distribution of spots in the model has a large effect on the results.
For longer periods the correlation is different which might be related to a drop in the activity for older stars.
the former can be assigned to the limitations of the model with very fast rotators
while our model usually gives a sort of ’average’ prediction. It is not clear which result is better in general.
